Ribd Insulated Steel Bottle with Flip Top Lid – Premium 750ml Stainless Steel Bottle

Stay refreshed wherever you go with our Ribd Insulated Steel Bottle with flip top lid, designed for people who value performance, durability, and modern style. Crafted using high-quality stainless steel, this bottle combines advanced insulation technology with a sleek ribbed design that looks as good as it performs. Whether you are heading to the office, gym, school, or outdoor adventures, this bottle ensures your drink stays at the perfect temperature for hours.

The PU Insulated outer body adds an extra layer of protection while maintaining a lightweight feel. This smart insulation helps keep beverages hot or cold for longer, making it ideal for tea, coffee, water, or energy drinks. With its ergonomic shape and premium finish, this stainless steel bottle is easy to carry and comfortable to hold throughout the day.

Drink Hot / Cold for 4–6 Hours with Advanced Insulation

Thanks to its efficient insulation system, this stainless steel bottle allows you to drink hot / cold for 4–6 hours without compromising on taste or freshness. Enjoy hot coffee during winter mornings or chilled water on hot summer days. The inner steel lining is food-grade, rust-resistant, and safe for daily use, ensuring long-term reliability.

The ribbed exterior not only enhances grip but also adds a stylish, modern look. The bottle is engineered to resist dents and scratches, making it a dependable companion for both indoor and outdoor use.

Durable & Light Weight Design for Everyday Use

Built to last, this bottle features a durable & light weight construction that makes it easy to carry without adding unnecessary bulk. Unlike ordinary bottles, the reinforced stainless steel body ensures long-term durability while remaining easy to handle. It fits conveniently in backpacks, car cup holders, and gym bags.

The thoughtfully designed silicon strap offers added convenience, allowing you to carry the bottle securely during travel, workouts, or daily commutes. This practical feature makes it a great choice for active lifestyles.

Flip Top Lid for Spill-Free Drinking

The flip top lid is designed for one-hand operation, providing quick and easy access to your drink while preventing spills and leaks. The secure locking mechanism ensures that your beverage stays safely inside the bottle, even when you’re on the move. This makes it suitable for school children, office professionals, and fitness enthusiasts alike.

750ml Capacity – Perfect Balance of Size & Convenience

With a capacity 750ml (approx.), this offers the perfect balance between hydration and portability. It provides enough volume to keep you hydrated for extended periods without the need for frequent refills, while still being compact enough to carry comfortably throughout the day.

  • Premium ribbed insulated steel bottle with modern design
  • High-quality stainless steel bottle for safe daily use
  • PU insulated outer body for enhanced temperature retention
  • Keeps beverages hot or cold for 4–6 hours
  • Durable & light weight construction for easy portability
  • Convenient flip top lid with leak-resistant closure
  • Comfortable silicon strap for easy carrying
  • Ideal 750ml capacity for office, gym, travel, and outdoor use

Why Choose?

This is a perfect blend of functionality and style. Designed to meet modern hydration needs, it supports a healthy lifestyle while reducing dependence on single-use plastic. Its premium materials, reliable insulation, and user-friendly features make it an excellent choice for personal use or corporate gifting. Upgrade your hydration experience with a that delivers performance, comfort, and long-lasting value. Choose this insulated stainless steel and enjoy your favorite drinks at the right temperature, anytime and anywhere.
